message.text: The Grep tool is hitting a ripgrep path issue, so I'll switch to using shell grep instead.

I have what I need now, so I want to double-check whether the markdown.Service interface has just the one private `service` struct implementing it, or if there are mocks or other implementations to account for.

Only one concrete implementation exists (the unexported `service` struct built by `goldmark`). No mocks or alternate implementations in the codebase.

h13.

**impl** — the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` (wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance, using `goldmark`'s core + `extension.GFM`, plus custom `TagExtension`/`MentionExtension`, and delegates markdown-to-markdown re-rendering to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` in `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`) — is the only concrete implementation of the `markdown.Service` interface (declared `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`) that executes at runtime.

**construction** — built exclusively via the `markdown.NewService(opts ...Option)` constructor (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-113`). In production it is constructed in exactly one place, `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:47-51`), with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` enabled. (Test-only construction also happens in `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`, and `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`.)

**holders** — the interface field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` is held by:
- `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`) — the original owner/constructor, used directly in `memo_service.go` (via `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`), `memo_mention_helpers.go` (`ExtractAll`), and `memo_service_webhooks.go` (`GenerateSnippet`).
- `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`) — receives the same instance passed in from `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` when constructed in `server/server.go:85`.
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) — a background runner that also receives/uses the same `markdown.Service` (via `NewRunner` and the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` helper).

So there is a single runtime implementation, constructed once per `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, and its instance is threaded through to `RSSService` and `memopayload.Runner` as the shared `markdown.Service` interface holder.
